options.name: filter
options.description: Filter out facts from the I(ansible_facts) dictionary. Uses shell-style L(fnmatch, https://docs.python.org/3/library/fnmatch.html) pattern matching to filter out the collected facts. An empty list means 'no filter', same as providing '*'. Filtering is performed after the facts are gathered such that no compute is saved when filtering. Filtering only reduces the number of variables that are added to the I(ansible_facts) dictionary. options.name: gather_subset
options.description: If specified, it will collect facts that come under the specified subset (eg. ipl will return ipl facts). Specifying subsets is recommended to reduce time in gathering facts when the facts needed are in a specific subset. The following subsets are available C(ipl), C(cpu), C(sys), and C(iodf). Depending on the version of ZOAU, additional subsets may be available.
